name: Kiriya Sumire
source:
[i]The Kind-Hearted Sixth Daughter[/i]

The youngest child of the family, who is quiet, reserved, and somewhat shy.

She looks up to Daisuke like an older brother and becomes attached to him.

Because she is younger than most of her other sisters, she often spends time with Kurenai.

Although she participates in the night-time rituals as a matter of tradition, she believes that she does not have the charm of her sisters, and so has little desire to actively compete with them.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/kiriya/main.html]Official Site[/url]]
